notes.title: Update 5.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Hope you're enjoying your week. This update focuses mainly on the main menu GUI. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Game Engine:

* Entirely new "Main Menu"

* Fixed low resolution text bug that occurred in some parts of the game

* Fixed an issue where holding "R" to restart the level would cause the game to have an aneurysm 

Levels:

* Fixed missing colliders to cauldrons on "Pharaohs".

* Added "Green Acres" test level

* Added UFO easter egg

UI:

* Completely reworked options menu. (AGAIN)

Coming Soon:

* Reworked movement system

* More Dynasty updates.

* "Halls of Anu" level.

* Game timer & high-score.

* More Steam achievements.

* Portals

* More SFX

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Update 4.29
notes.content:
Hello,

Lots of new stuff with this update. The biggest things are the new real-time lighting system, and the addition of the Dynasty preview level, which is still being designed.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890642/58a6d58632b601156b595d4c32a5def355105bab.jpg[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Game Engine:[/h1]

* Completely reworked lighting model for PC. Mobile version will retain original lighting.

* Added system for sound effects on the player and environment.

* Added a system to easily create animated obstacles and enemies.

* Fixed framerate drops on low end PC hardware when triggering multiple collisions.

[h1]Levels:[/h1]

* Added "Dynasty Preview" to playable levels. Only the first 700 meters has been assembled, but even that hasn't been finalized.

* Added more obstacles to "Pharaohs".

[h1]UI:[/h1]

* Completely reworked options menu. Now includes additional sound sliders and graphics options.

[h3]Coming Soon:[/h3]

* More Dynasty updates.

* "Halls of Anu" level.

* Game timer & high-score.

* More Steam achievements.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Update 4.28
notes.content:
2/20/2022

[i]Hello!

Just a minor update here. Mostly aesthetic changes and minor bug fixes. Hopefully will have a much bigger update soon.[/i]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890642/b35197e36a51decaf73691e638954a2392a5e7dd.jpg[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1][b]Game Engine:[/b][/h1]

* Fixed bug where player could buy store item without coins (hopefully).

* Reduced the game's overall file size.

* Fixed level loading error when hitting next level button on "Metropolis"

* Various bug fixes

[h1][b]Levels:[/b][/h1]

* Added more obstacles to "Pharaohs", changed background music and fixed a number of missing collision triggers on obstacles throughout the level.

* Changed "All seeing eye" animation.

* Added further background detail on "Pharaohs".

[h1][b]UI:[/b][/h1]

* Updated "Controls" UI style.

* Changed "Level Name" style.

[h1][b]Coming Soon:[/b][/h1]

* "Dynasty" level.

* "Halls of Anu" level.

* Game timer & high-score

* More Steam achievements.

* Better options menu.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
